title: ConfigApplyResult
description: JSON-encoded into CommandResult.detail. Overall status is done when every outcome is applied|unsupported|deferred (1.4: deliberately not applied now, with the reason; e.g. Wi-Fi off while Wi-Fi is the only network)|not-requested (1.7: the app doesn't request that permission), failed otherwise.

outcomes.description: keys: policies.<key>, kiosk, location, connectivity (1.5; unsupported for a mode the agent doesn't know), appPermissions.<package>.<permission> (1.7)
